templates.description: One agent researches the topic, one writes a draft and one reviews it. You approve the final file.
templates.name: Research, draft, review

templates.description: Three agents answer at the same time from different angles. When all three agree, one writes the answer from them, and you sign it off.
templates.name: Three takes, one answer

templates.description: An agent fixes what you describe in each project, the tests run (the agent fixes what they find), you review the changes and a pull request opens.
templates.name: Fix, test, open a PR

templates.description: In each project an agent moves one package to a new version and fixes what breaks, the tests run, you review the changes and a pull request opens.
templates.name: Bump a dependency everywhere

templates.description: Runs each project's tests on its current branch. A project whose tests fail waits for you; nothing is changed and no AI runs.
templates.name: Nightly test sweep
